classification: Historical local permission checkpoint plus final workflow source snapshot
writeOperations: Create tree preserving complete protected-base tree plus one custody JSON
Create immutable custody commit parented to protected base
Atomically create campaign-global tag ref; never update/delete/refund
candidateExecutionPermissions: Existing global contents/pull-requests/actions read only; no write override
credentialBoundary: Guard executes only separately checked-out protected-main helper; no candidate package installation/import/execution
ordinary.run removes GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN before every child
runTrustedExperienceReplay removes GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN before all browser/application children
Technical phase remote authorization occurs in the trusted ordinary parent; suite children receive only a one-use local lease
whyReadOnlyInsufficient: Read-only workflow history catches pre-reservation failed/cancelled attempts but does not provide atomic compare-and-create across executions. Concurrency queues do not persist consumption; artifact identities are run-scoped. The exact campaign-global CAS is the create-only Git ref. No existing accepted read-only store provides that operation.

approval.scope: contents:write ONLY for trusted campaign-custody and mainline-decision guard jobs; global and candidate/test/capture read-only; Product Experience child tokens stripped; no broader credential or branch-protection changes
